sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Regional Price Parities
sources.description: Metro and state cost-of-living index values (US average = 100).

sources.name: U.S. HUD Fair Market Rents (FMR)
sources.description: Typical monthly one-bedroom rent estimates by metro area and state.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
sources.description: National mid-level salary benchmarks by role family, adjusted for level and local cost of living.

sources.name: IRS Federal Income Tax Brackets & SSA Payroll Wage Base
sources.description: 2026 single-filer federal income tax brackets, standard deduction ($16,100), and FICA/Social Security cap ($184,500).

sources.name: Tax Foundation State & Local Income Tax Rates
sources.description: Effective state and local income tax rate estimates for middle-income single filers.

sources.name: BLS Consumer Expenditure Surveys & USDA Food Plans
sources.description: Single-adult monthly baseline estimates for utilities, groceries, transportation, health care, and personal spending.

sources.name: BLS Employee Benefits Survey (weighted against posting text)
sources.description: Benefits are extracted directly from the job posting and weighted by core coverage benchmarks.
